No withholding on payments to US persons under 26 USC 1441/1442, so paid gross."}],"notes":"PREPARED FOR SECOND REVIEW. NOT SIGNED OFF. Distribution D-002, Atlas Growth Fund I: USD 8,000,000. Record date 2026-12-15, payment date 2027-01-12. One component, D-002-A: a US-source dividend from Orion Manufacturing via Atlas Acquisition SPV (DOC-0202). Investor list frozen from the commitments at the record date; the 12 payee lines match the unit percentages.

RECONCILIATION (C3.4): gross 8,000,000, tax 1,175,900, net 6,824,100. The schedule gross matches the notice. Payee lines for the intermediaries are split by beneficial owner. I-002 Feeder (1,920,000) goes to I-010 / I-011 / I-012 at 50 / 30 / 20. I-007 Sterling (480,000) goes to I-013 / I-014 at 62.5 / 37.5. The other 10 payees map one to one. No D-002 case, schedule or determination rows exist in the clearance tables yet. I have read-only access, so step 1 (opening the case) has to be done in the system.

KEY JUDGMENTS FOR THE REVIEWER:
1. Rule version at the payment date. R-02 v2027.1 (10%, 2026 Protocol Art. 3, marked "illustrative") takes effect 2027-01-01, so I used it for every LU treaty line instead of v2026.1 (15%). The rulebook does not close v2026.1 (eff_to is null), so the two versions overlap. Please confirm the protocol is in force. At 15%, tax on the six cleared LU lines (gross 5,279,000) would be 263,950 higher.
2. I-006 Meridian Holdings I is recorded as cleared, but I put it on the default rate. Its ownership-based limitation-on-benefits claim relied on DO-003, which ended 2026-07-31. The new ownership is circular: Holdings II owns 30% and the Jersey Meridian Family Trust 70%, which still traces 100% to the Jersey trust. WF2 change case K-006 has been open since 2026-08-20. It needs a decision before 2027-01-12. If the claim is upheld, the rate would be 10% (tax 24,000 instead of 72,000).
3. I-011 Moselle moved its seat to Belgium on 2026-12-01 (DOC-0111). The LU treaty claim fails and CL-002 still shows the feeder as fully cleared. Open WF2 for I-011 and ask for a new W-8BEN-E. The rulebook has no BE treaty rule.
4. I-013 Echternach (S3.5): F-013 ends 2026-12-31, before the payment date. Passed to WF2 with 2027-01-12 as the deadline. The records also conflict: the DOC-0107 withholding statement cites a W-8BEN-E dated 4 March 2025, and TS-013 starts 2025-03-04, but F-013 is recorded as signed 2023-03-06 and valid to 2026-12-31. If a 2025 form exists it would be valid to 2028 and fix the problem (rate 10%, tax 30,000 instead of 90,000). Please check this.
5. Possible 5% rate for I-010 (R-03). I-010's look-through vote is 50% of the feeder's vote in AGF1 × 80% of Orion. The two sources disagree on the feeder's vote: shareholding H-005b (from 2026-12-01) says 25%, which gives exactly 10.0% and meets the threshold; the commitment table (C-002) says 24%, which gives 9.6% and does not. It is also unsettled whether a holding through a transparent partnership counts. I applied 10% as the documented rate; the 5% claim needs the reviewer's decision.
6. I-003 Kirchberg holds class A2 units under side letter DOC-0003 (dated 2026-11-24). It is not digitised and its content is unknown. Check it for any distribution or tax terms before sign-off.

OTHER POINTS:
- Holds: I applied the default rate rather than holding any payment. The fund's power to hold is not confirmed because the LPA (DOC-0001) is not digitised.
- Notices to investors (C3.7) are needed before payment, with the item needed to cure:
  - I-015: a new W-8BEN-E.
  - I-014, via Sterling: a tax form for client account 7731.
  - I-013: a renewed W-8BEN-E.
  - I-011: a new form reflecting its Belgian residence.
  - I-006: the K-006 outcome or ownership/LOB support.
- Data conflicts to correct:
  - I-016: commitment 3% (used, consistent with the line) vs shareholding H-006 3.5%.
  - I-002: 24% vs 25% vote (see point 5).
  - The I-002 W-8IMY (F-002) has no document reference, and I-002 has no country of residence.
- Date anomaly: today is 2026-10-15, but several records are dated later: DOC-0202 (2026-12-07), DOC-0003, DOC-0111 (2026-12-18), and the I-011 residence record (recorded 2026-12-20). I treated them as known facts. Confirm the data is current.
- Totals by outcome:
  - Cleared: 6 lines at 10% and 2 at 30%.
  - Default: 5 lines (I-011, I-006, I-013, I-014, I-015), gross 1,696,000, tax 508,800.
  - Not applicable: 2 lines (W-9)."}
